prediction: The indexOf method will be found to use 'buffer.length' instead of 'size' in its loop boundary calculation.
experiment_rationale: The failure is a classic boundary condition error where the search logic fails to respect the active size of the data structure, leading to invalid operations on the underlying array.

This invalid index then causes an AIOOBE when passed to the deletion logic.
